outcome.description: You authorize the transfer. The corvette acknowledges, banks away, and is gone.
You walk him through the cost of pressing the issue. He grumbles, says you're not worth the noise, and breaks off.
He listens for two seconds and laughs over the channel. The weapons run hot.
He veers off without another word.
He doesn't believe you. Or doesn't care. Either way, his guns are powering up.
The channel cuts. The corvette accelerates.
The collector logs the entry, salutes without warmth, and burns away. The line is closed. For now.
The collector hears you out, scratches a note, and revises the figure to nothing this run. He warns you the line stays open.
He closes the slate. Says the books don't bend. The skiff's guns swivel.
The collector says nothing. Just makes a tick on the slate. The skiff opens fire.
He accepts the credits, laughs at your story, and tells one of his own. Then he waves you through like an old friend.
You match him line for line. He calls you a menace, says your stories are worse than his, and lets you pass.
Your last line lands wrong. The smile drops. He decides he wants the credits the hard way.
He shouts something colorful and chases.
She stamps a receipt and transmits it to your records. The cutter banks away with bureaucratic precision.
She pauses, taps her slate, and turns a small shade of grey. She apologizes for the confusion and moves off without filing the receipt.
She listens, then explains in detail which subsection your reading missed. Either pay or watch the cutter's authorization for force.
She logs the refusal with mechanical patience and authorizes engagement.
